mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM orders WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
SELECT id, order_no, buyer_id, seller_id, total_amount, status, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM orders WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY gmt_create DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no FROM orders WHERE status = 1 AND gmt_create < #{deadline}
